title: Continuity in σ of the blown-up slice integrals
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵐ := μHE[m], M ⊆ ℝ^P any set, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ Hᵐ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K, x ∈ ℝ^P, f : ℝ^{P+1} → ℝ continuous with compact support, Φ(s, u) := (s, u_1, …, u_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ u))), and r > 0. Then the function σ ↦ ∫_{blowUpMap x r '' M} f(Φ(σ, w))·θ(x + r·w) dHᵐ(w) is continuous on ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ f : Eucl (P + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Continuous (fun σ : ℝ => ∫ w in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons σ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ w))) * θ (x + r • w) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)))
